    Access issues inherited from 阳朔 Yangshuo

    Most local villagers welcome climbing and do not present any problems. However, certain crags have had historical issues. If there is signage at any crag asking for small donations (1-5rmb for vehicle parking), please be willing to pay. This money goes directly to the local villager whose land we are using and supports the local associations' agreement with the villagers. The money is minimal and the result has been very beneficial to resolving any issues. Thank You.

    Selected Guidebooks more Hide

    Lines poster: Panda's Thumb

    Author(s): Alex Buisse/Mont Blanc Lines

    Date: 2025

    One of the first formations to be climbed in Yangshuo, back in the late 90s, Panda's Thumb (sometimes also called Thumb Peak) is a great beginner multipitch area, especially with its ultra-classicHappy New Year(line 4). Its incredibly easy access comes at a cost, though: located right above one of the busiest roads in the area, ascents will be anything but peaceful!

    Buy
    • montblanclines.com
    ⓘ
    Lines poster: Middle Finger - Sport Wall

    Author(s): Alex Buisse/Mont Blanc Lines

    Date: 2025

    Facing its cousinthe Panda's Thumb, the Middle Finger is another of the historical Yangshuo formations where a lot of early development took place. These days, it is more popular for its sport wall, a 2-3 pitches wall of great rock with challenging but accessible routes.

    Buy
    • montblanclines.com
    ⓘ
    Yangshuo Rock Climbing Guidebook

    Author(s): Andrew Hedesh

    Date: 2018

    ISBN: 9780998728605

    A comprehensive guidebook describing the sport climbing at Yangshuo in southern China, covering nearly 800 routes across 40 different crags.
